text:
natalie: ok team, new midseason side game idea: "MVP Pick'em Survivor". each week pick one player you think will score the most across all games. if your pick wins you survive. last person standing buys the celebratory pizza. thoughts? :pizza:
greg: love it. adds skill to the chaos. what are the rules?
sam: rules proposal: picks lock at 1st kickoff, no repeating the same player more than twice in a row, tie -> highest single-play scoring event wins (td>fg>pts).
li: can we have a veto for obviously impossible picks (like injured/out)? administrative veto only if player inactive at lock.
mike: also add a jailbreak card: once per season you can swap a pick after lock if you pay a $5 charity penalty. raises stakes.
natalie: i like the jailbreak card. raises drama and funds a snack budget. :money_with_wings:
gif-bot: natalie posted a gif: https://giphy.com/flex-survive (animated pizza celebration)
poll-bot: @channel Poll created: "Activate Pick'em Survivor this week?" Options: 1) Yes 2) No. Vote with :one: or :two:. Poll ends in 1d.
greg: side rule suggestion: if multiple people pick the same player and that player wins, they all survive. last person standing still only one loser.
sam: deep question: if two players tie for top scorer and someone picked one of them, do they survive? tie rule needs clarity.
li: tie rule: if your pick is among the tied top scorers you survive. keeps it simple.
mike: can we record picks in a public Google Sheet so drama is verifiable? screenshots ok but sheet cleaner.
natalie: sheet will be live. i'll make columns: week, pick, timestamp, jailbreak used? screenshot optional for receipts.
greg: also mini side-bets: loser of week does a short "victory speech" in #random and wears a silly avatar for 48h. must be enforced.
sam: avatar enforcement is brutal but hilarious. we should probably have an appeals committee (greg, natalie) to keep it spicy but fair.
li: appeals committee sounds ominous but fair. will abstain from bribery.
mike: meta rule: if someone forgets to pick by lock they auto-pick the highest projected scorer per ESPN. fair but painful.
natalie: agreed. auto-pick brutalizer engaged. also i'll seed the spreadsheet with week 1 sample picks so folks can see format.
gif-bot: sam posted a gif: https://giphy.com/whoops-auto-pick (facepalm)
poll-bot: Update: 6h in, poll leaning yes 10->2. Poll ends at 2019999999.
greg: ok if this goes live i'm declaring my intent to use the jailbreak card on week 3 for maximum theatrics.
sam: tracked. i'll record your theatrics and monetize the highlight reel.
li: charity choice for $5 jailbreak penalties? suggestions: local food bank or coffee shop gift cards for the on-site interns.
mike: vote: food bank. more impact.
natalie: food bank makes sense. i'll set a collection link and post when jailbreaks happen.
greg: last logistics Q: what qualifies as "player scored the most"? total fantasy points or raw points? be explicit.
sam: raw points across stat line (fantasy points is messy given league differences). use official box score points where applicable, else we default to fantasy scoring if both agree.
li: agreement note: all ties and disputes go to appeals committee first, then public vote if unresolved. transparency is key.
mike: i'm in. sign me up and reserve a pizza slice for the eventual champion. :pizza_slice:
natalie: signup sheet posted: https://docs.google.com/sheetmvp (add your slack handle and whether you want the jailbreak card). starting Week 1 picks close at kickoff Sunday. may the boldest picker win. :crossed_fingers:
